Game 1 of the Salesforce FIDE World Championship 2026 saw an epic opening decision by Gukesh. As Javokhir opened the game with 1.e4 Gukesh opted for something that no one would have imagined. The Berlin Defense. Check out this insane opening choice and how the game transpired in the youngest World Championship match of all time.
